# AQ Beds

> AQ Beds is a UK bed and bedroom furniture retailer selling direct to customers.
> The range covers ottoman beds, divan beds, luxury beds, sofas, wardrobes and
> bedroom furniture. Delivery is free across the UK and payment is cash on
> delivery. Nothing is paid online.

Canonical domain: https://www.aqbeds.com
Site language: en-GB. Prices are shown in GBP on each product page.
Machine-readable index of this file's full version: https://www.aqbeds.com/llms-full.txt

## What is sold

- [All products](https://www.aqbeds.com/shop): every bed and furniture product in one catalogue.
- [Ottoman beds](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/ottoman-beds): beds with gas-lift storage under the whole mattress base.
- [Divan beds](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/divan-beds): divan bases with built-in drawers.
- [Luxury beds](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/luxury-beds): wingback, sleigh and gold-strip detail bed frames.
- [Sofas](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/sofas): velvet sofas and sofa beds.
- [Wardrobes](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/wardrobes): free-standing wardrobes, flat-packed.
- [Sliding wardrobes](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/sliding-wardrobes): sliding-door wardrobes, flat-packed.

Beds are sold in 2ft6 small single, 3ft single, 4ft small double, 4ft6 double,
5ft king and 6ft super king, depending on the model. On most bed models the
mattress is included on some sizes and optional on others; the size list on each
product page states which.

## Delivery rules

- Free delivery across the UK, including Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
- Orders confirmed Monday to Saturday before 20:00 Europe/London are delivered
  the next day.
- Orders placed after 20:00 Europe/London are treated as the next day's order.
- Sunday orders are delivered on Tuesday.
- Monday is not a delivery day, and no deliveries are made on UK bank holidays.
  A computed date that lands on one of those days moves to the next delivery day.
- The customer can choose a later delivery date at checkout.
- Delivery address is taken at checkout; the courier inspects the item with the
  customer at the door.

## Payment

- Cash on delivery only. No card payment, no finance, no buy-now-pay-later.
- The customer pays the courier when the item is delivered and inspected.
- Orders are placed through the website checkout or through the WhatsApp number
  below; neither takes an online payment.

## Guarantee and returns

- Every item is inspected at the door before payment.
- A faulty item reported at delivery, or within 24 hours of delivery, is replaced
  free of charge with next-day delivery.
- Returns are accepted at the time of delivery only; damage or a fault must be
  reported before the courier leaves or within 24 hours.
- Full terms: https://www.aqbeds.com/returns
